capabilities: Track daily task engagement across week, month, and year views
Count engaged vs not-engaged days using a customizable checked-task threshold
Calculate completion percentages weighted by importance and difficulty ratings
Track current and longest engagement streaks
Flag unchecked high-importance tasks in a dedicated list
disambiguation: Not a task manager or to-do list; it only reports statistics on how you engaged with tasks already in your daily notes.
extras: Not yet in the Community Plugins store; installation is via BRAT or manual download of release files. Only works with markdown daily notes named in YYYY-MM-DD format.
motivation: The author built it on the idea that tracking engagement matters more than perfection: showing up consistently and doing important, reachable tasks counts more than completing everything.
problem: Obsidian's daily notes and task checkboxes give no statistics on which days you failed to engage with your tasks.

relations.evidence: Works with Daily Notes (core plugin) or Periodic Notes (community plugin)
Auto-Detection: Automatically finds your daily notes folder from Daily Notes or Periodic Notes plugin settings

summary: Task accountability tracker that scores daily-note task engagement, shows missed days, and tracks current and longest streaks.
